results.source: OWASP ASVS 5.0.0 complete English document plus CSV/JSON exports
results.coverage: front matter pp.1-22, chapters V1-V17 pp.23-95, appendices A-E pp.96-119; all 345 requirement IDs checked
supported: three verification levels L1/L2/L3 with 70/183/92 requirements
unconfirmed: trust-boundary framing: zero occurrences of trust boundary across PDF, CSV, JSON and source markdown
results.conclusion: The leveled clause is supported and three of four framing clauses are supported, but the trust-boundary clause is not present. The conjunction is not fully supported.

results.revision: Final, 17 February 2026; 21 numbered sections plus appendices A-B
results.evidence: Section 11.4 Revocation states that the specification does not define a revocation process.
results.nuance: Key revocation status fields exist in 8.7.2-8.7.3 and trust-mark revoked status in 8.4.2, but no revocation process is defined.
results.conclusion: The removed claim is contradicted by the specification's own Section 11.4.
